environment.note: Performance numbers below were measured on this single development machine at this point in time; they are not a universal or hardware-independent benchmark.

vision_detection_quality.methodology: n=4 synthetic scenario clips only (fire_smoke, person_down, route_obstruction, normal). This is NOT a statistically meaningful benchmark -- it is an illustrative, fully-reproducible smoke test of the pipeline's detection logic on deterministic synthetic footage, not a claim of real-world accuracy. Positive class = 'scenario reaches confirmed state'.

vision_frame_latency_per_scenario.methodology: Timed OpenCV5Processor.process() + scenario detector .detect() + TemporalAnalyzer.update() only, per frame, over 200 pre-generated frames per scenario at 15.0 fps synthetic source framerate. Synthetic-frame *rendering* time is excluded (frames generated before timing starts). Measured on THIS development machine only -- not a universal/hardware-independent number.

agent_decision_latency.methodology: Timed AgentPolicy.evaluate() alone (pure/deterministic function, no I/O) over 15 representative evidence dicts x 200 repeats = 3000 calls.

end_to_end_latency_per_scenario.methodology: Timed VisionPipeline.process_frame() (processor + detector + temporal + evidence extraction, including evidence-frame JPEG encoding once a signal is present) followed by AgentPolicy.evaluate(), per frame, over 200 frames per scenario. Measured on this development machine only.

agent_evaluation.methodology: Cartesian product of scenario x state x confidence run through the actual AgentPolicy.evaluate(), compared against an independently re-derived expectation of the documented rules in backend/app/agent/policy.py. 'matches_documented_policy' is a live pass/fail, not asserted blindly.

cloud.reason: No live AWS deployment exists in this environment; local-mode only (storage_backend=local, no AWS credentials configured).
